name: trait method
code: <?php trait A {public function hello(){return "hi";}} class C {use A;} echo (new C())->hello();

name: trait method override by class
code: <?php trait A {public function hello(){return "trait";}} class C {use A; public function hello(){return "class";}} echo (new C())->hello();

name: trait method overrides parent
code: <?php class P {public function hello(){return "parent";}} trait A {public function hello(){return "trait";}} class C extends P {use A;} echo (new C())->hello();

name: trait property
code: <?php trait A {public $x=5;} class C {use A;} echo (new C())->x;

name: trait property update
code: <?php trait A {public $x=5;} class C {use A;} $o=new C();$o->x=8;echo $o->x;

name: trait protected method
code: <?php trait A {protected function f(){return 6;}} class C {use A;public function test(){return $this->f();}} echo (new C())->test();

name: trait private method
code: <?php trait A {private function f(){return 6;}} class C {use A;public function test(){return $this->f();}} echo (new C())->test();

name: trait method calls property
code: <?php trait A {public function inc(){ $this->x+=2; }} class C {use A;public $x=2;} $o=new C();$o->inc();echo $o->x;

name: trait static method
code: <?php trait A {public static function f(){return 5;}} class C {use A;} echo C::f();

name: trait static property
code: <?php trait A {public static $x=5;} class C {use A;} echo C::$x;

name: trait implements interface
code: <?php interface I{public function f();} trait A{public function f(){return 3;}} class C implements I{use A;} echo (new C())->f();

name: trait parent method
code: <?php class P{public function f(){return 2;}}trait A{public function f(){return parent::f()+3;}}class C extends P{use A;}echo (new C())->f();

name: trait multiple distinct
code: <?php trait A {public function a(){return 1;}} trait B {public function b(){return 2;}} class C {use A,B;} echo (new C())->a()+(new C())->b();
